grader_mapping.title: Drill name clips under text-spacing override
grader_mapping.reason: Same one-line, cut-off tool names on the find page as D03; with extra text spacing the drill name is clipped again even at 1280 px, and letting names wrap fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: Tab jumps from the last tool back up to Search tools
grader_mapping.reason: Focus order between the results and the search form runs against the visual order on the find page, which is D01's focus-order clause caused by the CSS reorder of form and list; the review reads the DOM order the other way round from the ground truth, but it is the same reorder.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar hides the focused loan-length button
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar paints over a focused control on the tool page because nothing keeps the page clear of it; D08 cites day buttons, but the defect is the bar covering whatever control receives focus.

grader_mapping.title: Masthead link never reached in a Tab walk
grader_mapping.reason: In the loan-open state Tab cannot leave the open loan-length list, so the walk never reaches the masthead link; this is the D09 trap seen from what it blocks (criterion A11Y-25), and fixing the trap fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse of DOM and arrow-key order
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D11: the session cards are laid out in reverse, so Saturday 10 is last on screen while first for Tab, arrow keys and screen readers.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length control named by its value, not its label
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D16: the loan-length button is announced as 'One week, button, collapsed' with no mention of what is being chosen.

grader_mapping.title: Session dots vanish in forced colours at phone widths
grader_mapping.reason: The same dot-only session marker that replaces 'Open' below 480 px (D20); in forced colours it disappears altogether, and keeping a visible word at phone widths fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: No-match search shows no message and announces nothing
grader_mapping.reason: D02: a search for 'sewing machine' leaves a full list on screen with an empty status region and no 'no tools match' message.

grader_mapping.title: Collection day chosen twice, first choice not carried over
grader_mapping.reason: Main point is D23: the day picked on the tool page must be chosen again as a session in the basket, nothing preselected, with a 'Choose a pick-up session' error; its remarks on closed days and mismatched dates are secondary.

grader_mapping.title: Tool-card headings at the same level as their section heading
grader_mapping.reason: Screen-reader members who move by headings get the ten tool names at the same level as 'Search', 'Tools' and 'Opening times', so the outline does not show which headings are tools and level navigation cannot skip the list; not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' outside every landmark
grader_mapping.reason: The page's main action sits outside main and every region, so a screen-reader member who navigates by landmarks and explores main does not find the Reserve button there; minor but genuine, and not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Second Confirm press makes a second reservation
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D12: Confirm stays enabled during the 1.5 s wait and a repeat press allocates a second reservation number.

grader_mapping.title: No visible busy state on Continue and Confirm
grader_mapping.reason: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible happening during its 1.5 s wait, which is D12; a visible, disabled busy state fixes it (the Continue half is the same pattern).

grader_mapping.title: Tab cycles inside the open loan-length list
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D09: Tab moves to the next option and wraps, so a keyboard user cannot leave the open list.

grader_mapping.title: Basket hold expires with no notice, warning or extension
grader_mapping.reason: D10: 'Items are held for you while you finish' shows no time although the hold lasts ten minutes.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold makes every Continue fail with 'Something went wrong'
grader_mapping.reason: D10's lapsed-hold path: Continue answers 'Something went wrong. Try again.', which states neither the cause nor a working fix; the review adds that retries keep failing.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are rejected only at confirm
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D06: every day is selectable and a closed day is refused only on the confirm page, with no way back to the calendar.

grader_mapping.title: Tab reaches results before the search form above it
grader_mapping.reason: Same CSS reorder of the search form and results on the find page with focus order against the visual order (D01's focus-order clause); the review places it above 480 px with the DOM order reversed relative to the ground truth, but it is the same mechanism.

grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse, bottom-up order
grader_mapping.reason: D11: sessions display Wednesday 28 to Saturday 10 while reading and arrow-key order run the other way.

grader_mapping.title: 330 px column minimum overflows the 320 px viewport
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D05: minmax(330px) in a 288 px content box makes the cards overflow by about 42 px.

grader_mapping.title: Card names cut to one line, hiding what tells the drills apart
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03: nowrap with ellipsis hides 'two batteries' vs 'one battery' and the full name is nowhere else on the card.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode green badge below contrast, no tint
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D04: #2f7d4a text on the #1d2622 card surface at about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' not announced or tied to the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D19: the error is a plain paragraph, not a live region and not referenced by the calendar, so a screen reader announces only the focused day.

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from' hint not linked to its input
grader_mapping.reason: A screen-reader member tabbing to the date field is not read the hint that explains what the date means, because the input has no aria-describedby; not in the ground truth (D25 concerns the hint's wording, not its association).

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' toast gone after about 1.3 s
grader_mapping.reason: D07: the only feedback after the press is a toast that disappears almost at once, leaving the small header count as the only cue.

grader_mapping.title: Search field below the whole tool list on phones
grader_mapping.reason: D01: on phones the ten cards come first and the search sits about 2000 px down with no hint that it exists.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket
grader_mapping.reason: Its harm is that the reservation looks done when a basket, a session and a confirmation still follow, the false belief D26 describes.

grader_mapping.title: Basket confirmation vanishes, way on scrolled out of view
grader_mapping.reason: About the feedback after the press: the toast is gone in seconds, the only lasting sign is the header count out of view, and nothing nearby leads on, which is D07 rather than D26's false belief.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
grader_mapping.reason: The visual side of D11: the reversed layout puts Wednesday 28 first and the wanted Saturday 17 fourth of six.

grader_mapping.title: Header still shows Basket (1) after confirming
grader_mapping.reason: D18: the basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed', so the header keeps 'Basket (1)'.

grader_mapping.title: Date filter hidden behind an icon-only Filters button
grader_mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only three-line button as the only way to the 'Available from' date and the category filter.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts days the library is closed
grader_mapping.reason: D06: Monday 12 October can be chosen and is accepted into the basket with no word that the library is closed.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts days before the tool is available
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D14: a day before the pressure washer's 'Available from' date is accepted without warning.

grader_mapping.title: Change from confirm clears details already typed
grader_mapping.reason: Main point is D22: after Change, the basket and Continue, the membership number and name are empty; its last sentence (session not preselected) is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
grader_mapping.reason: Both identifiers use the 'FT-' prefix, so a member reading 'FT-4471' on the done page, or asked for one number at the desk, can give the other; not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Membership-number error does not say what is wrong
grader_mapping.reason: The same unforgiving membership-number check on the confirm page, whose error only repeats the example instead of saying what is wrong with what was typed; part of D17.

grader_mapping.title: No lasting sign that the tool is in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: D07: after the short toast the page looks unchanged and only the off-screen header count records the press.

grader_mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
grader_mapping.reason: D10: 'held for you while you finish' with no time shown for a ten-minute hold.

grader_mapping.title: Remove empties the basket with no undo
grader_mapping.reason: One mis-tap on 'Remove' on a phone loses the item with no undo, and getting it back means finding the tool and re-choosing loan length and day; not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Basket accepts a session before a held tool is available
grader_mapping.reason: D14: the basket offers every session and nothing checks the tools' 'Available from' dates.

grader_mapping.title: Fourth tool accepted despite the three-tool limit
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D21: the stated limit of three is not enforced and four tools go through to confirm.

grader_mapping.title: Date-filter hint contradicts what the filter keeps
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D25: the hint says 'on or after this day' while the filter hides a tool collectable after the chosen day.

grader_mapping.title: Stale session error with dead link after emptying the basket
grader_mapping.reason: After the last tool is removed the empty basket still says 'Choose a pick-up session' and links to a list that is gone, telling the member to do something impossible; minor, not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Date-filter results change out of view on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Caused by D01's phone layout, which puts the filter panel below the list; putting the form above the list, as D01 requires, fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Every calendar day is a Tab stop, arrow keys do nothing
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard and switch members must step through up to 21 day buttons to get past the calendar to 'Reserve this tool', and the arrow keys a visual grid invites do nothing; minor, not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: +44 mobile number rejected
grader_mapping.reason: D17 lists '+44 7700 900123' among the valid forms the confirm page rejects.

grader_mapping.title: Same placeholder wrench on every tool card
grader_mapping.reason: An appeal remark: the names identify the tools and nothing in the flow fails for lack of photos.

grader_mapping.title: Drill names truncated identically on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03 at 375 px: both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'.

grader_mapping.title: Search and filter below all ten tools on phones
grader_mapping.reason: D01's phone reordering of the tool list and the search form.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest-first
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of the D11 reversed session layout.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions before the chosen pick-up day are offered
grader_mapping.reason: The basket offers sessions that contradict the day already chosen on the tool page and nothing reconciles the two, which is D15.

grader_mapping.title: Session cards wrap into a ragged one-plus-five grid
grader_mapping.reason: Desktop layout polish: the cards stay readable and selectable; the reversed order behind the layout is mapped separately to D11.

grader_mapping.title: Unthemed native date input and default select
grader_mapping.reason: Taste: native date and select controls work well on phones, and differing baselines hinder no one.

grader_mapping.title: No-results search without an empty-state message
grader_mapping.reason: D02: 'sewing machine' leaves tools on screen and no message says nothing matched.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up calendar has no month or year label
grader_mapping.reason: The item only observes that the grid 'starts at Fr 9 and runs to Th 29 with weekday headers only' and that no 'October 2026' heading or month navigation is visible; it names no harm. Those dates are one unbroken run within a single month, so month navigation would add nothing, and the same review says the month is given as soon as a day is chosen ('the status line names the month only after a day is chosen', F-0131) and that the days are announced in full ('Saturday 17 October, open'). Nothing it shows gives a basis for a member misreading or mis-choosing the day, so the orientation harm is speculative; like the critics' other execution remarks, it is not a problem for members.

grader_mapping.title: Reserve button off the content column
grader_mapping.reason: Alignment at 1280 px is visual polish; the button is visible and works.

grader_mapping.title: Details lists with different label column widths
grader_mapping.reason: Visual polish; the details stay readable.

grader_mapping.title: Dark theme drops the chip on green badges
grader_mapping.reason: The complaint is shape, not legibility: in dark mode the green badges 'have no visible chip background' while the grey ones keep theirs, 'so the two badge variants no longer share a shape' (DES-coherence, severity 1). D04 is the text contrast of #2f7d4a on #1d2622 at 3.1:1; the item never mentions contrast or reading, and restoring the chip, the fix it implies, would not fix that contrast, since the review's own fix for D04 is the dark --color-ok text token, with the tinted background named only as an extra ('it should also get back the tinted background'). As with D07 and D26, the same badge read for a different harm is a different problem, and a shape mismatch between badge variants hinders no member, so not-a-problem.

grader_mapping.title: Header still shows Basket (1) after confirming
grader_mapping.reason: D18; duplicate of F-0062.

grader_mapping.title: No brand identity beyond the name
grader_mapping.reason: Brand and appeal critique; a matter of taste that does not affect reserving.

grader_mapping.title: Action-bar button not aligned with the column

grader_mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0110; appeal remark.

grader_mapping.title: Brand is just the name beside a stock icon
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0123; taste.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names truncate at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03: the two drills become indistinguishable.

grader_mapping.title: Search below all ten cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: D01's phone reordering of the tool list and the search form.

grader_mapping.title: Session cards: one wide card over five cramped ones
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0114; desktop layout polish.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0060, the D11 reversed layout.

grader_mapping.title: Details lists use two value-column offsets
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0119; visual polish.

grader_mapping.title: Toast covers the calendar weekday header
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0130; negligible.

grader_mapping.title: Grey band below the footer at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0124; visual polish.

grader_mapping.title: Right half of the 1280 px layout empty

grader_mapping.title: Day button and Reserve bar touch at 768 px
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Saturday 17 October' day and the fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar have 0 px between them on the tool page (the review cites 2.4.11) because nothing keeps the calendar clear of the fixed bar. At 768 px this is D08's bar lying over the calendar rows.

grader_mapping.title: Two-battery drill name clipped in its card at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The card name overflows a box with hidden overflow and is cut off. This is the one-line truncation of tool names on the find page, which hides the ending that tells the drills apart.

grader_mapping.title: Tab jumps from the last card back up to Search
grader_mapping.reason: On the find page, focus runs against the visual order of the search form and the result list. D01 names this as part of the form/list reorder ('keyboard focus also runs against the visual order').

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions reversed against reading and focus order
grader_mapping.reason: The sessions are laid out in reverse on screen, while the DOM, screen-reader and Tab order run earliest first. This is exactly D11.

grader_mapping.title: Esc does not close the loan-length list
grader_mapping.reason: D09: inside the custom loan-length listbox, Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user cannot leave without choosing.

grader_mapping.title: Tab and Shift+Tab cannot leave the loan-length list
grader_mapping.reason: D09's keyboard trap: Tab cycles among the options until one is chosen.

grader_mapping.title: Open-day dots vanish under forced colours at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Same cause as D20: below 480 px, session days are marked only by a small dot instead of 'Open'. Under forced colours the dot disappears, so on the phone layout open days look like closed ones; a visible marker that does not rely on colour fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: Card and basket item headings at the same level as 'Tools'
grader_mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. Screen-reader members who browse by headings get each tool name as an h2, the same level as the 'Tools' section that contains it, so the outline does not show the tools as items of that section and they cannot skip the list by heading level. Minor, but genuine.

grader_mapping.title: Basket does not preselect the day chosen on the tool page
grader_mapping.reason: D23: the basket repeats the chosen day but selects no session and shows an error on Continue, so the member enters the date a second time.

grader_mapping.title: 330 px grid minimum overflows a 320 px screen
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D05's cause: minmax(330px) columns in a 288 px content box make the cards run past the edge at 320 px.

grader_mapping.title: No-match search leaves old results and status
grader_mapping.reason: D02: a search with no matches leaves the previous list on screen and shows no message.

grader_mapping.title: Tab captured inside the loan-length list
grader_mapping.reason: D09: Tab moves through the options and wraps around, so focus cannot leave the open list.

grader_mapping.title: Repeat Confirm presses create extra reservations
grader_mapping.reason: D12: Confirm stays enabled during the 1.5 s wait, and a second press allocates a second reservation number.

grader_mapping.title: No visible pending state on Continue and Confirm
grader_mapping.reason: For Confirm, this is D12's 'nothing visible says that anything is happening' during the 1.5 s wait that invites a second press. The Continue half is the same missing progress feedback.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold reported as 'Something went wrong'
grader_mapping.reason: D10: when the ten-minute hold, which the page never states, runs out, Continue shows a generic error that does not say what happened.

grader_mapping.title: After the hold expires every Continue fails
grader_mapping.reason: This is D10's lapsed-hold path. 'Try again.' cannot succeed because the hold never restarts, so the error leaves the member with nothing to do, which D10 names ('does not say what to do').

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed and not-yet-available days
grader_mapping.reason: The core is D06's: any calendar day, closed days included, can be chosen and added without warning. The half about days before the tool is available belongs to D14, which F-0142 reports on its own.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm accepts a day before 'Available from'
grader_mapping.reason: D14: a tool booked for a day before its availability date goes through to 'Reservation confirmed' without any check.

grader_mapping.title: Closed-day error comes late with no link back
grader_mapping.reason: D06: the closed day is refused only on the confirm page, and the only way back to the calendar is the browser.

grader_mapping.title: Per-tool day and basket session never reconciled
grader_mapping.reason: D15: the tool's pick-up day and the basket's session are chosen separately and never checked against each other, so the summary can show two dates.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-theme success token drift, badge at 3.1:1
grader_mapping.reason: D04: in the dark theme, the 'Available from' badge text (#2f7d4a) on the card surface (#1d2622) is about 3.1:1.

grader_mapping.title: Find page tab order puts results before the form shown above
grader_mapping.reason: The find page's reorder of form and results makes keyboard focus run against the visual order, which is the focus half of D01. The item also notes that the form sits below all results at phone widths.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar covers the end of the tool page
grader_mapping.reason: D08: nothing reserves space for the fixed bar, so the last calendar row, the footer and days reached by Tab can sit under it.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' not announced
grader_mapping.reason: D19: the error is a plain paragraph with no live region and nothing points to it, and focus moves to the first day button.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line
grader_mapping.reason: D03: nowrap with an ellipsis removes the ending that tells the two drills apart.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names are h2 under h2 'Tools'; .h3 class undefined
grader_mapping.reason: The same heading-structure problem as F-0030, and not in the ground truth. Screen-reader members get a flat outline, and on the basket the undefined .h3 class also shows each item name as large as the section heading.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and mobile formats rejected without normalising
grader_mapping.reason: D17: the two patterns reject lower-case, missing-hyphen, +44 and spaced variants, and nothing but a trim is applied.

grader_mapping.title: Done page shows FT-4471 when no reservation exists
grader_mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. A member who reopens the confirmation later, from history or a bookmark once the tab's stored reservation is gone, sees 'Reservation confirmed' with a number that was never issued. They may quote a wrong number at the desk or think a reservation exists.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tool limit not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: D21: the stated limit of three tools is checked neither in the basket nor on confirm.

grader_mapping.title: Unknown tool id silently opens the first tool
grader_mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. A member who follows a stale or mistyped tool link lands on the 18 V drill page with no 'not found' message, so cannot tell the link failed, and Reserve would add the drill instead of the tool they meant.

grader_mapping.title: Done page repeats the tool name in a hidden span
grader_mapping.reason: D24: a visually hidden span repeats the tool name, so screen readers read it twice.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket
grader_mapping.reason: It also describes the brief toast (D07), but its main harm is the false belief that the tool is reserved ('every reason to believe the job is done and close the page'). By the rule, that goes to D26.

grader_mapping.title: Basket asks for the pick-up session again
grader_mapping.reason: D23: the day chosen on the tool page is not carried into the session choice, so the member answers the same question again.

grader_mapping.title: Both drills truncate to the same name at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03: on phones both cards read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'.

grader_mapping.title: 'Basket (1)' still shown after confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: D18: the basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed', and the header still reads 'Basket (1)'.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts days the tool cannot be collected
grader_mapping.reason: Like F-0141, its core is D06's unrestricted calendar, and it leads with the closed Monday 12 October being accepted. The pressure-washer example belongs to D14, which F-0142 already reports.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm summary shows two collection dates
grader_mapping.reason: D15: after the session is changed, the confirm page shows the tool's day and a different session date.

grader_mapping.title: Change link drops the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: D13: 'Change' returns to the basket with no session selected.

grader_mapping.title: Membership number lost after leaving confirm
grader_mapping.reason: D22: details typed on the confirm page are lost after 'Change' and back, so the member types them again.

grader_mapping.title: Filters button is an unlabelled icon
grader_mapping.reason: D01: the only way to the 'Available from' date filter is a three-line icon button, so members are unlikely to notice that they can filter by day.

grader_mapping.title: Basket says items are held but not for how long
grader_mapping.reason: D10: the basket says 'Items are held for you while you finish' but shows no time.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation and membership numbers share the FT- prefix

grader_mapping.title: Fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer and desk phone number

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after 1.2 s with no next step nearby

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link drops the chosen session

grader_mapping.title: Returning to the confirm page clears the details already typed
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R20, B R21). 'Coming back to confirm also clears the details the member already typed', so the member types them again on a phone. That is D22.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tools-per-member limit not enforced in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R21, B R22). 'The three-tools-per-member rule isn't enforced in the basket.' That is D21.

grader_mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R22, B R23). The hidden #c-tool copy makes screen readers read the tool name twice. The review uses 'confirmation page' for the done page throughout (it is also where it saw 'Basket (1)' after confirming), so this is D24.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up session' error link points at a container that cannot take focus
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R23, B R24). grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R24, B R25). grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only on the confirm page
grader_mapping.reason: The tool page "offers all 21 days"; a closed Friday 16 October is accepted and refused only by the confirm button ("The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day."), and "That error has no link, and the only way to fix it is to go back to the tool page". grader_mapping.title: Pick-up date asked a second time in the basket

grader_mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date can be chosen

grader_mapping.title: Unshown ten-minute hold leaves the basket stuck on 'Something went wrong'

grader_mapping.title: Confirm button stays active; a double tap makes two reservations

grader_mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look identical

grader_mapping.title: Search box below all ten cards on a phone; icon-only Filters
grader_mapping.reason: "The search box is about 2,100 px down, after all ten cards", the focus order "doesn't match what's on screen", and the fix is to "put search first everywhere, and give 'Filters' a visible text label instead of an icon only". grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
grader_mapping.reason: "Green text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 has a contrast of 3.07:1, against a required 4.5:1" matches D04's colours and ratio. grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions listed in reverse date order, against focus order
grader_mapping.reason: On a phone the sessions "run 28 Oct at the top down to 10 Oct at the bottom", and "Keyboard and screen-reader order is the reverse" (row-reverse with wrap-reverse). That is D11.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches shows and announces nothing
grader_mapping.reason: "'hammer' … leaves all 10 tools on screen, and nothing is announced", and the fix is to show "No tools match 'hammer'". That is D02's silent no-match that leaves the old list in place.

grader_mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase typed
grader_mapping.reason: The review shows "drill with two batteries" finding nothing although the two-battery drill is in the library, and asks to "match each word separately". grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' gives only a 1.2-second toast
grader_mapping.reason: "'Reserve this tool' gives a 1.2-second toast and nothing else. The harm named is the brief feedback after the press, not a belief that the tool is already reserved, so D07 rather than D26.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps keyboard users
grader_mapping.reason: "Tab and Escape just cycle between the options; I tested this", and "Clicking outside doesn't close it either"; the fix is "a native <select>, or a pair of radio buttons". That is D09: a custom listbox a keyboard user cannot leave except by choosing an option.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and mobile number formats too strict
grader_mapping.reason: "It rejects 'ft-01234' and '07700 900 123'", and the fix is to "Accept any capitalisation and any spacing". Both examples are in D17.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket with no session selected
grader_mapping.reason: "'Change' goes to the basket with no session pre-selected (the journey expects the member to see what they chose)", and the fix is to "pass slot back". That is D13. The separate bullet "Rename the link 'Change session'" is its own item (R18), not part of this one.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' wipes the name and number already typed
grader_mapping.reason: "it loses the name and number already typed", and the fix is to "keep the details in sessionStorage". That is D22: the confirm fields come back empty after Change.

grader_mapping.title: Rename the 'Change' link 'Change session'
grader_mapping.reason: The third bullet of item 10, "Rename the link 'Change session'", is a bare wording suggestion with no harm stated. grader_mapping.title: Pages scroll sideways at 200% zoom
grader_mapping.reason: "The find page is 346 px wide in a 187 px viewport, because of minmax(330px, 1fr)" and "Members zoomed to 200% will have to scroll sideways"; the fix is "minmax(min(330px,100%),1fr)". That is D05's 330 px minimum grid columns, which overflow at 320 px and at 200% zoom; the other pages being "259 px wide" is a broader statement of the same reflow problem.

grader_mapping.title: Basket not cleared after confirming
grader_mapping.reason: "After confirming, the basket still shows 'Basket (1)'", and the fix is to "Clear it on the done page". That is D18.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation number looks like a membership number
grader_mapping.reason: "'FT-4471' uses the same prefix as 'FT-01234'". The member types one FT- number on the confirm page and is given another on the done page, so at collection they can quote the wrong one and the volunteer looks for the wrong record: minor but real at the step where the reservation is used, and not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tool maximum stated but not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: "The 'maximum three tools' rule is stated but not enforced": the basket takes more tools than the find page allows. That is D21.

grader_mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
grader_mapping.reason: "Screen readers hear the tool name twice on the done page, because of the hidden #c-tool copy". That is D24.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the footer phone number
grader_mapping.reason: "The sticky 'Reserve this tool' bar covers the footer phone number at the bottom of the tool page", and the fix is "bottom padding equal to the bar's height". D08 is this fixed bar with nothing keeping the page clear of it, and it names this phone case ("the footer and the desk phone number sit under the bar"). The review misses the focus-obscured part.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only at the last step, with no way to change the day
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D06. A: The tool page accepts Monday 12 October, a closed day. It is refused only at the last step, after the details are filled in, and the message has no link back to change the day. That is D06. B: The calendar 'lets you pick any day', including closed days; the closed Monday 12 October is caught only at the last step after the details are filled in, and the message has 'no link and no way to change the day'. That is D06: a closed day is selectable, refused three steps later on the confirm page, with only the browser leading back.

grader_mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date can be chosen and are never caught
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D14. A: The calendar allows days 'before the tool is even back', and 'the tool not available yet case is never caught', so the reservation would be confirmed. That is D14. B: The calendar allows 'days before the tool is even back', and the 'tool not available yet' case is never caught: an open day before 21 October 'would have confirmed'. That is D14 (days before the Available-from date are neither marked nor checked, and the reservation is confirmed).

grader_mapping.title: The per-tool pick-up day and the basket session can contradict each other, with nothing flagging it
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D15. A: The tool had a 12 October pick-up day, the basket accepted the 10 October session, and nothing flagged the clash. The confirm page can show both dates. That is D15: the day and the session are never reconciled. B: Choosing the Saturday 10 October session for a tool set to Monday 12 October raised nothing, and the confirm page can show a per-tool pick-up day and a different session that contradict each other. That is D15: the day chosen on the tool page and the session chosen in the basket are never reconciled.

grader_mapping.title: An 8 px green dot is the only open-day marker on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D20. A: At phone width the only sign of an open day is an 8 px dot, which is hard to see for older eyes. That is D20. B: Raised inside the fix: the 8 px green dot is 'the only sign of an open day at phone width' and hard to see for older eyes. That is D20 (below 480 px the word 'Open' gives way to an 8 px dot, so open days are easy to miss on a phone).

grader_mapping.title: The 10-minute hold is hidden; once it lapses, Continue only says 'Something went wrong. Try again.'
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D10. A: The basket shows no hold time ('Items are held for you while you finish'). After it expires, Continue gives a misleading generic error and offers no way forward. That is D10. The WCAG 2.2.1 point is about the same time limit. B: The hold time is not shown ('Items are held for you while you finish'), and once it lapses Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' every time, with no warning or way to get more time (2.2.1). That is D10; the fix it gives (show the hold, let members extend it, say plainly it expired and offer to hold again) fixes the defect.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm stays active through a silent 1.5 s wait, so a double tap makes two reservations
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D12. A: The button stays enabled and nothing visible changes. A double tap gave FT-4471 and FT-4472 for one drill. That is D12. B: Confirm waits 1.5 s with no visible change and stays active; a double tap produced 'FT-4471 and FT-4472' for one drill. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Continue on the basket page waits 1.2 s with no visible change
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. A: This is not D12, which is another button on another page and causes duplicates, and not D10, which is the hidden hold and the misleading message. A member on a phone who taps Continue sees nothing change for over a second, so she cannot tell whether the tap registered and taps again or gives up. B: A different control from Confirm: Continue on the basket page also shows no visible change for 1.2 s, so a member on a phone cannot tell the tap registered and taps again or thinks the site has stalled. The ground truth has the silent wait only on Confirm (D12) and Continue's wrong error once the hold has lapsed (D10); a busy state on Continue fixes neither.

grader_mapping.title: The basket is not emptied after confirming, so the same tool can be confirmed again
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D18. A: After confirming, the masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' and the same tool can be confirmed a second time. That is D18. B: After confirming the masthead still shows 'Basket (1)', 'so the same tool can be confirmed again'; the fix is to clear the basket and hold on success. That is D18.

grader_mapping.title: Truncated card names make the two drills look the same
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D03. A: Names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'. That is D03. B: Names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' and the two-battery and one-battery drills cannot be told apart. That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: On phones, search sits below all ten cards and the filters hide behind an unlabelled three-line icon
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D01. A: Below 480 px, search and filters are moved about 2,100 px down, under the cards, and the date filter sits behind an unlabelled icon that reads as a menu. That is D01. B: Below 480 px the search box and filters are moved under all ten cards (about 2,100 px down) and the date filter is behind an unlabelled three-line icon that reads as a menu. Both halves are D01.

grader_mapping.title: The dark-mode 'Available from' badge is too faint (about 3.1:1)
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D04. A: In dark mode, #2f7d4a on #1d2622 gives about 3.1:1, below the 4.5:1 needed for 16 px bold text. That is D04. B: In dark mode #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text against the 4.5:1 needed (1.4.3). That is D04.

grader_mapping.title: The 'Added to your basket' toast lasts 1.2 s with no link, and the basket count has scrolled out of view
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D07. A: This is about the feedback after pressing 'Reserve this tool': a brief toast and nothing lasting in view. It does not say members will believe the tool is reserved, so it maps to D07 rather than D26. B: About the feedback after pressing 'Reserve this tool': the toast lasts 1.2 s with no link and the basket count has scrolled out of view. It does not say the member believes the tool is reserved, so it maps to D07, not D26.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and says nothing
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D02. A: Searching 'drill with two batteries' leaves the old list of 10 tools on screen, and the status message is never updated. That is D02. B: 'drill with two batteries' leaves the old list of 10 tools on screen and the hidden status message is never updated. That is D02.

grader_mapping.title: Search matches only the exact phrase
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. A: This is not in the ground truth; D02 covers only the missing no-match feedback. 'drill with two batteries' finds nothing even though that drill exists, so a member who describes a tool in her own words cannot find it, and this is the very choice the main journey depends on. B: Raised in the fix 'match individual words rather than the exact phrase': a plain-words search for the two-battery drill finds nothing although that drill is listed, so members who search in their own words may decide the library hasn't got the tool. D02 is only the missing no-results message, and fixing it would not make the search find the drill.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions appear in reverse date order, so the visual order and the keyboard and screen-reader order disagree
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D11. A: row-reverse with wrap-reverse puts 28 October at the top and 10 October at the bottom, while keyboard and screen-reader order stay chronological. That is D11. B: row-reverse with wrap-reverse shows 28 October at the top and 10 October at the bottom while keyboard and screen-reader order stay chronological. That is D11.

grader_mapping.title: The phone and membership number checks reject normal entries
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D17. A: '07700 900 123', '+44 7700 900123' and 'ft-01234' are all rejected because nothing is normalised. That is D17. B: '07700 900 123', '+44 7700 900123' and 'ft-01234' are all rejected; the fix is to strip spaces, accept +44 and uppercase before checking. That is D17.

grader_mapping.title: The loan-length dropdown traps the keyboard
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D09. A: Inside the open list Tab loops and Escape does not close it; tapping outside does not close it either. That is the D09 custom-listbox trap. B: Tab loops inside the open list and Escape doesn't close it, which is the keyboard trap in D09. That tapping outside doesn't close it either is the same widget's missing dismissal, and the radio-button fix removes D09.

grader_mapping.title: The three-tool limit is not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D21. A: The 'up to three tools' rule is not enforced and all ten tools can be added. That is D21. B: The 'up to three tools' rule isn't enforced: 'You can add all ten.' That is D21.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' is not announced, and focus jumps to 9 October
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D19. A: The error is not linked to the calendar, so a screen-reader user hears only the date that focus jumps to. That is D19. B: The error isn't linked to the calendar and focus jumps to the 9 October button, so a screen-reader user hears only the date. That is D19.

grader_mapping.title: The results grid scrolls sideways at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D05. A: Because of minmax(330px, 1fr), 346 px of content sits in a 320 px window. That is D05. B: At 320 px the grid gives 346 px of content in a 320 px window because of minmax(330px, 1fr) (1.4.10). That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: The fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and desk phone number and can hide focused controls
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D08. A: The bar covers the footer, including the desk phone number, and can hide keyboard-focused items (WCAG 2.4.11), because no padding keeps the page clear of it. That is D08. B: The fixed Reserve bar covers most of the footer, including the desk phone number, and can hide focused items when tabbing (2.4.11); the fix is bottom padding. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' on the confirm page drops the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: tool-library-D13. A: The Change link goes back to the basket without the session already chosen. That is D13. B: The 'Change' link on the confirm page 'doesn't keep the session already chosen'. That is D13.

grader_mapping.title: No skip link
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: not-a-problem. A: This is a bare checklist remark. The review shows no long block that keyboard users must get past on every page (the only masthead content it mentions is the basket count), so it shows no harm to these members. B: A bare checklist remark: the review shows no long block of repeated links, and no missing headings or landmarks, that a keyboard user would have to get past, and members mostly use phones, where a skip link plays no part. No harm to these users is shown.

grader_mapping.title: The calendar does not show the month name
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. A: This is not in the ground truth. The calendar is where members choose the pick-up day, and a grid of day numbers with no month leaves them to work out which month they are choosing, which is easy to get wrong when the month changes. B: The calendar is how a member picks the pick-up day; a grid of day numbers with no month leaves an older member on a phone to work out which month they are choosing in, and days become ambiguous if the grid runs past the end of the month. grader_mapping.title: The done page gives neither the loan length nor a return date
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. A: This is not in the ground truth. The done page is the member's record of the reservation. Without the loan length or a return-by date she cannot check which loan she chose or tell when the tool is due back. B: The done page is the member's record of the reservation; without the loan length chosen or when the tool is due back, the member has nothing to check against and may return it late. grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be picked and are refused only at Confirm, with no way back
grader_mapping.reason: A R1 and B R1 agree. grader_mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are not blocked
grader_mapping.reason: A R2 and B R2 agree. grader_mapping.title: Pick-up date chosen twice, and the two can disagree
grader_mapping.reason: A R3 and B R3 agree. Same as D15: the tool-page day and the basket session are not reconciled ('Nothing links the two'), so the confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' above 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October'; the closed-day check reading the tool-page day is a consequence of the same unreconciled dates. grader_mapping.title: Ten-minute basket hold expires silently, then a misleading error and a lock-out
grader_mapping.reason: A R4 and B R4 agree. grader_mapping.title: Truncated names make the two drills look identical on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: A R5 and B R5 agree. Same as D03: names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills show as about 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…'.

grader_mapping.title: On phones the results come before search, and the date filter is behind an icon-only button
grader_mapping.reason: A R6 and B R6 agree. Same as D01: at 480 px and below 'the results come before the search form', and the 'Available from' filter 'sits behind an icon-only button below that'.

grader_mapping.title: Desktop: form shown first but coded after the results
grader_mapping.reason: A R7 and B R7 agree. Wrong as stated: the ground truth gives the document order as form then results, so on desktop, where the form is shown first, visual and keyboard/screen-reader order agree; the real mismatch is at 480 px and below, already counted under R6 (D01).

grader_mapping.title: 330 px minimum column makes the page scroll sideways at 320 px and high zoom
grader_mapping.reason: A R8 and B R8 agree. Same as D05: the results grid's 330 px minimum column width makes the page scroll sideways 'At 320 px wide, or at high zoom'.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no results leaves the old list and shows no message

grader_mapping.title: Double-tapping Confirm makes two reservations
grader_mapping.reason: A R10 and B R10 agree. Same as D12: Confirm stays enabled through the 1.5 s wait with no visible busy state, and a second tap creates a second reservation number, so 'The desk sets the tool aside twice'.

grader_mapping.title: Basket Continue button has no busy state
grader_mapping.reason: A R11 and B R11 agree. grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
grader_mapping.reason: A R12 and B R12 agree. Same as D04: in dark mode the badge's #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is 3.07:1 for 16 px bold text against the 4.5:1 needed; the CSS not following DESIGN.md's #8fd1a8 is the cause and fix of the same failure. grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode badge background is the same colour as the card
grader_mapping.reason: B R13; A had no separate item, having merged this remark into its R12 (see settled). 'The badge background is also the same colour as the card, so it doesn't look like a badge' is a styling remark: the legibility harm is the text contrast already mapped to D04 under R12, and no effect on members of the badge not looking like a badge is stated or evident.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length dropdown traps Tab and ignores Escape
grader_mapping.reason: A R13 and B R14 agree. Same as D09: once the list is open, 'Tab and Shift+Tab only cycle through the options, Escape doesn't close it', so it can only be left by choosing an option; that tapping outside does not close it is the same can't-leave-the-list problem.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name is only 'One week'
grader_mapping.reason: A R14 and B R15 agree. Same as D16: the button's accessible name is just its current value, 'One week', without 'Loan length', so a screen-reader user is not told what is being chosen.

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after about 1.2 s with no next step
grader_mapping.reason: A R15 and B R16 agree. Feedback after the press, so D07: the message 'disappears after about 1.2 s', too fast for older members, and the small 'Basket (1)' header link is the only lasting way forward; the item does not claim the member believes the tool is already reserved, so not D26.

grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse order
grader_mapping.reason: A R16 and B R17 agree. Same as D11: row-reverse and wrap-reverse put Wed 28 Oct at the top on a phone, while 'Screen readers and keyboard users get them earliest first'.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and phone checks too strict
grader_mapping.reason: A R17 and B R18 agree. Same as D17: 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are rejected because nothing normalises them before the strict patterns are applied.

grader_mapping.title: 'Open' becomes an unlabelled 8 px dot on phones
grader_mapping.reason: A R18 and B R19 agree. Same as D20: 'Below 480 px it becomes an unlabelled 8 px dot', so on a phone it is easy to miss which days are sessions.

grader_mapping.title: Done page shows a made-up reservation number without reservation data
grader_mapping.reason: A R19 and B R20 agree. Not in the ground truth: opened without reservation data (for example reopened later from history), the done page shows 'FT-4471' as though a reservation exists, a false confirmation a member could rely on or quote at the desk; an edge case, but misleading.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation numbers share the 'FT-' prefix with membership numbers
grader_mapping.reason: A R20 and B R21 agree. Not in the ground truth: reservation numbers (FT-4471) and membership numbers (FT-01234) share the 'FT-' prefix, so a member, many of them older, can give the wrong number at the desk or type a reservation number into the membership field; minor.

grader_mapping.title: Basket not emptied after confirming
grader_mapping.reason: A R21 and B R22 agree. Same as D18: after confirming, the basket still holds the tools unless the member taps 'Reserve another tool', so the same tool can be reserved again.

grader_mapping.title: 'Up to three tools' limit not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: A R22 and B R23 agree. Same as D21: the stated limit of three tools is not enforced, so a reservation can include more tools than the desk will lend.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and desk phone number
grader_mapping.reason: A R23 and B R24 agree. Same underlying problem as D08, stated more narrowly: nothing keeps the tool page clear of the fixed bar, so 'the footer, which has the desk phone number' sits under it at the bottom of the page, a case D08 names; it omits the focused day buttons hidden under the bar.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' is not announced; focus jumps to the first day
grader_mapping.reason: A R24 and B R25 agree. Same as D19: when Reserve is tapped with no day chosen, the error 'isn't read out' and 'Focus moves to the first day button instead'.

grader_mapping.title: Card tool names are h2 inside the 'Tools' h2
grader_mapping.reason: A R25 (real-unseeded) and B R26 (not-a-problem) split; settled as not-a-problem (see settled). The review says only that tool names on cards are h2 inside the 'Tools' h2 and should be h3, and names no effect on members; every tool name is still a heading a screen-reader member can jump to and hear, so the level costs nothing in finding or reserving a tool. A markup tidy-up, not a barrier.

grader_mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice (hidden #c-tool)
grader_mapping.reason: A R26 and B R27 agree. Same as D24: on the done page 'the hidden #c-tool makes screen readers read the tool name twice'.

grader_mapping.title: 10-minute basket hold lapses unannounced and leaves an error that trying again can't fix
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R1, B R1). The basket only says 'Items are held for you while you finish', 'No page says how long the hold lasts', and after 10 minutes 'every tap on Continue shows "Something went wrong. Try again."': D10's untimed hold and misleading error. The timer that never resets and the missing warning or extension describe the same hold.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only after Confirm, with no way back
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R2, B R2). 'If the member picks a closed day, nothing happens until the very end', then 'The library is closed on Friday 16 October… Choose another day.' with no link, and 'The confirm page and the basket can't change the day': D06.

grader_mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are accepted and confirmed
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R3, B R3). 'The tool's "Available from" date is never checked. You can reserve the sander (back 21 October) for Saturday 10 October and the reservation goes through', so 'The member then turns up and the tool isn't there': D14.

grader_mapping.title: On phones the 'Open' label becomes an 8 px dot
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R4, B R4). 'On a phone (under 480 px) the "Open" label is hidden and only an 8 px dot is left', with the fix to keep the word visible at phone width rather than the dot: D20.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up day asked twice: a day on the tool page, then a session in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R5, B R5). 'The tool page asks for a pick-up day, and then the basket asks for a pick-up session', so the member gives the same date twice in two forms: D23.

grader_mapping.title: The tool's pick-up day and the basket's session can disagree
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R6, B R6). The confirm page shows 'Cordless drill… pick up Saturday 17 October' next to 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October', and 'The member and the desk can't tell which one counts': D15, with the same example.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm shows no busy state, so a second tap makes two reservations
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R7, B R7). 'The only sign that anything is happening is aria-busy, which nothing styles… A second tap on Confirm saves a second reservation', and the done page lists 'FT-4471 and FT-4472': D12. The note that Continue also looks dead for 1.2 seconds is part of the same point.

grader_mapping.title: Basket is not emptied after a confirmed reservation
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R8, B R8). 'Clear the basket after a successful confirm. At the moment it still shows "Basket (1)" on the done page, which invites a second confirm': D18.

grader_mapping.title: The two cordless drills truncate to the same name on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R9, B R9). 'Tool names are cut to one line with an ellipsis', so on a 375 px phone both drills 'show as roughly "Cordless drill 18 V, co…"': D03.

grader_mapping.title: On phones the tool list comes before the search form
grader_mapping.reason: Settled alignment (A R10, which also held the icon-only filters; B R10); the mapping is agreed. 'Under 480 px the results move above the search form, so a phone user has to scroll past every card to search': D01's reordering, fixed by 'Put search first on phones'.

grader_mapping.title: Filters reachable only through an icon-only button
grader_mapping.reason: Settled alignment (part of A R10; B R11); both map it to D01. 'The filters are also behind an icon-only button', fixed by 'Show "Filters" as text next to the icon': D01 names the icon-only button as the only way to the date and category filters on phones.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no match leaves the old list and shows no message
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R11, B R12). 'Searching for something that isn't stocked (for example "hammer") changes nothing: the old list stays and there is no "No tools found" message': D02.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails text contrast
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R12, B R13). 'Dark mode sets --color-ok: #2f7d4a on --color-ok-tint: #1d2622', and 'The text contrast is 3.07:1, below the 4.5:1 that 16 px bold text needs': D04. The tint matching the card comes from the same two tokens and the same fix.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar day-cell outlines are faint (about 1.6:1)
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R13, B R14). Each cell carries its day number, which is what tells members it is a day to pick, so the outline is not needed to find or operate it, and the review itself says the selected day's '2 px green border does carry the selection'; 'The cells barely read as buttons' names no harm to members.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and focused calendar days
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R14, B R15). 'The bar is fixed and 72 px tall, but the page reserves only 8 px of space for it. The footer, which holds the desk phone number, ends up underneath it', and 'the focused day can scroll under the bar (WCAG 2.4.11, Focus not obscured)': D08.

grader_mapping.title: Reserve bar has no padding for the iPhone home indicator
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R15, B R16). 'The bar doesn't pad for the iPhone home indicator' is a separate claim read from the stylesheet alone; the review shows nothing the indicator would cover on this page and names no harm, so it is speculative.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions are displayed in reverse order
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R16, B R17). 'row-reverse and wrap-reverse show the sessions newest first… Keyboard and screen-reader order is still oldest first': D11.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length list traps Tab and ignores Escape
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R17, B R18). 'Tab is captured to cycle through the options, Escape does nothing… A keyboard user can only leave by choosing an option': D09. Not closing on an outside tap is the same cannot-leave problem.

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after 1.2 seconds and offers no next step
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R18, B R19). 'The toast is too brief for many members to read, and nothing points them onward', the only route being 'the small "Basket (1)" link in the header': the feedback after the press, D07. It does not argue that members believe the tool is already reserved, so not D26.

grader_mapping.title: The three-tool limit isn't enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R19, B R20). 'mention the 3-tool limit. The limit isn't enforced anywhere at the moment': D21's basket that takes a fourth tool.

grader_mapping.title: Phone and membership checks reject autofilled and common formats
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R20, B R21). The phone check rejects '+44 7700 900123', '07700 900 123' and '07700-900123', and 'The membership check rejects "ft-01234", "FT 01234" and "01234"', with the fix to normalise the input and 'say what is wrong with it': D17.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and reservation numbers look alike (FT-01234 and FT-4471)
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R21, B R22). Not in the ground truth. 'Membership is "FT-01234" and reservations are "FT-4471". At the desk, and in the confirm form, it's easy to give one for the other': a member can put the reservation number in the membership field and be rejected, or quote the wrong number at collection.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' returns to the basket without the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R22, B R23). 'The link goes to basket.html without the current session, so the choice isn't pre-selected': D13.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' link's accessible name is only 'Change'
grader_mapping.reason: Settled mapping (A R23 not-a-problem, B R24 real-unseeded). The review asks for 'Change pick-up session', 'with the extra words visually hidden if needed', so on screen the link already sits with the session it changes; the review shows no second 'Change' link to confuse it with and no member misled or blocked, and a link may take its purpose from that context (WCAG 2.4.4). Polish, not a problem these members would hit.

grader_mapping.title: A reservation can be confirmed with an empty basket
grader_mapping.reason: Settled alignment (A R24, which also held the confirmation text and done.html opened directly; B R25); the mapping is agreed. Not in the ground truth. If the session's storage is lost, 'the confirm page shows "Your basket is empty." but still confirms', so a member is told a reservation went through when nothing is set aside and may go to collect it.

grader_mapping.title: Done page promises a confirmation text that is never sent
grader_mapping.reason: Settled (part of A R24; B R26 not-a-problem). 'The done page then says "See your confirmation text", but no text is ever sent' rests only on the pages and app.js holding no code that sends a text; a text would come from the service behind the pages, which those files don't show, so the review has no basis that members wait for a text that never comes.

grader_mapping.title: done.html opened directly shows a made-up 'FT-4471'
grader_mapping.reason: Settled (part of A R24; B R27 not-a-problem). 'Opening done.html directly shows a made-up "FT-4471"' is the page's default content; members reach it by confirming and the review gives no route by which one would open it directly, so no member is shown being misled. The false confirmation itself is R25.

grader_mapping.title: Hidden duplicate of the tool name on the done page is read twice
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R25, B R28). 'a hidden duplicate of the tool name (#c-tool, done.html:38) makes screen readers read the tool twice': D24.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' error isn't tied to the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R26, B R29). The error 'isn't linked to the calendar with aria-describedby': D19's message in a paragraph 'that the calendar does not reference, so it is not announced'.

grader_mapping.title: Error summary's '#sessions' link doesn't move focus to the first radio
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R27, B R30). The link 'scrolls to the list', and the next Tab starts from its target, so the first radio is one Tab away; the review shows no member stranded, so this is a refinement, not a barrier.

grader_mapping.title: role=alert plus moving focus reads the error summary twice
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R28, B R31). At worst 'some screen readers read the error summary twice'; the errors are still heard and nothing is misread or blocked, so this is verbosity rather than a problem for members.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days can be picked; refused only at Confirm, with no way back
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R1, B R1). Same as D06: the calendar on the tool page lets a member pick a closed day with no warning. The refusal ('the library is closed that day') comes only after tapping Confirm reservation, and the day 'can't be changed from the basket or the confirm page', so the member has to go back to the tool page and redo every step.

grader_mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are never checked
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R2, B R2). D14: nothing marks, disables or checks the days before the 'Available from' date, so 'the sander is available from 21 October, but you can reserve it for 10 October'. This is the same fault as the ground truth's tile-saw example.

grader_mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session can disagree
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R3, B R3). D15: the day picked on the tool page and the session picked in the basket 'are separate choices' that nothing reconciles, so the confirm page can say 'pick up Saturday 17 October' for the tool and 'Wednesday 21 October' for the session.

grader_mapping.title: Unannounced 10-minute basket hold ends in a generic error that retries can't clear
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R4, B R4). D10: the basket says only 'Items are held for you while you finish' and shows no time, and after ten minutes Continue shows only 'Something went wrong. Try again.' The point that retrying never helps belongs to the same lapse handling. The review's fix (state the limit, say plainly when it runs out, offer to hold the tools again) fixes D10.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line, so the two drills look identical on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R5, B R5). D03: names are forced onto one line and cut off with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, c…' and 'two batteries' versus 'one battery' is hidden.

grader_mapping.title: On phones the search form sits below all ten tool cards
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R6, B R6). D01: under 480 px the CSS 'moves the results above the search form', so a phone user has to scroll past every card to reach search and the date filter.

grader_mapping.title: Filters button is an unlabelled three-line icon that looks like a menu
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R7, B R7). D01 names the three-line icon button, which has no text, as the only way to the date and category filters. The review's visible 'Filters' label is a narrower fix for the same problem: members not finding the filters.

grader_mapping.title: Desktop keyboard order said to reach the results before the search form
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R8, B R8). Wrong as stated: D01 gives the document order as form then results, and the reorder applies only at 480 px and below. At desktop width, focus reaches search first, so no one has to 'tab through all ten tool links before reaching search'. The real order mismatch is the phone reorder, which is already R6 (D01).

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list and says nothing
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R9, B R9). D02: 'if nothing matches, the old list stays on screen, and screen readers hear nothing', so the member cannot tell whether the search ran or found nothing.

grader_mapping.title: Search said to match only exact phrases ('battery' vs 'batteries')
grader_mapping.reason: Settled (A R10 not-a-problem, B R10 real-unseeded; see settled). The review claims a member searching 'battery' 'sees the full list unchanged' because 'whole phrases are matched exactly'. Its own evidence contradicts this: one drill's name ends 'one battery', which contains 'battery'. Its fix, 'Match each word separately', would not make 'battery' match 'batteries' either. The no-results part is D02 (R9).

grader_mapping.title: Confirm form rejects normal membership and mobile number formats
grader_mapping.reason: Settled alignment (A R11 and R12, both D17; B R11, D17; see settled). D17: the membership number must be exactly 'FT-' plus five digits in capitals and the mobile '0xxxx xxxxxx', with no normalising. So 'Ft-01234' (iPhone capitalisation), 'FT01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' (autofill) and '07700 900 123' are all rejected.

grader_mapping.title: Double tap on Confirm reservation books the tool twice
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R13, B R12). D12: the button stays active during the 1.5-second wait and nothing visible changes ('only aria-busy changes'). Each tap allocates a new reservation number, so a double tap gives 'FT-4471 and FT-4472'.

grader_mapping.title: Basket Continue also stays active with no visible change during its wait
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R14, B R13). This is neither D12 (the Confirm button and its double booking) nor D10 (the message when the hold has lapsed): 'Same pattern in the basket: Continue has the same wait.' Nothing visible changes while it waits, so a member on a phone cannot tell whether the tap registered. They tap again or think the site is stuck.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge is 3.07:1 and has no visible shape
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R15, B R14). D04: in the dark theme the badge text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is 3.07:1, below 4.5:1. The badge background matching the card comes from the same badge's dark-theme colour settings, and the same change fixes it (--color-ok and --color-ok-tint).

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed in reverse date order on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R16, B R15). D11: row-reverse with wrap-reverse puts the earliest session last on screen although it comes first in the document, so arrow keys and screen readers 'run against what's on screen'.

grader_mapping.title: After 'Reserve this tool' the toast is brief and nothing leads on to the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R17, B R16). This is about the feedback after the press: the toast 'is visible for only 1.2 seconds', nothing on screen moves the member towards the basket, and the only way on is the small 'Basket (1)' link. It does not say the member believes the tool is reserved, so it goes to D07, not D26.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed bottom action bar covers the focused day and the footer phone number
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R18, B R17). D08: the fixed bar is 72 px tall but the page leaves only 8 px of space below the content. A focused calendar day can scroll under the bar, and the desk phone number in the footer is partly hidden.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length list can't be left with Tab, or closed with Escape or a tap outside
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R19, B R18). D09: while the custom listbox is open, Tab and Shift+Tab only move between the options and Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user cannot leave without choosing. Not closing on a tap outside is the same fault: the list cannot be dismissed. The radio-button fix removes both.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day' error not announced; focus jumps to a closed day
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R20, B R19). D19: the error is in no live region and the calendar does not reference it, so screen readers don't announce it. Focus jumps to the first day, 'a closed Friday'.

grader_mapping.title: After confirming, the basket stays full and the hold timer keeps running
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R21, B R20). D18: after 'Reservation confirmed' the basket still shows the confirmed tools. Clearing the basket and the timer on confirmation, as the review proposes, fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Done page opened without a reservation shows a made-up number
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R22, B R21). Not in the ground truth. A member who reopens the done page without a stored reservation sees 'a made-up number', FT-4471, presented as a real confirmation. They may believe a tool is waiting, or quote that number at the desk.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation numbers look like membership numbers
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R23, B R22). Not in the ground truth. Both are 'FT-' plus digits (FT-4471, FT-01234), so a member can give the desk the wrong one, or type a reservation number into the membership field and have it rejected.

grader_mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R24, B R23). D24: the visually hidden '#c-tool' copy next to the visible list item makes screen readers read the reserved tool's name twice.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page 'Change' link's name doesn't say what it changes
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R25, B R24). Not D13, which is about Change dropping the chosen session; renaming the link would not fix that. A screen-reader member who tabs to the link or lists the page's links hears only 'Change' and cannot tell it is for the pick-up session.

grader_mapping.title: Results grid's 330 px minimum column scrolls sideways at 320 px and 200% zoom
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R26, B R25). Exactly D05: the 330 px minimum column overflows the content box at 320 px and at 200% zoom, so the page scrolls sideways.

grader_mapping.title: 'Up to three tools at a time' isn't enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R27, B R26). D21: nothing checks the stated three-tool limit, so the basket takes a fourth tool and the reservation is confirmed.

grader_mapping.title: Done-page fallback points to a confirmation text members aren't told about
grader_mapping.reason: Agreed (A R28, B R27). Not in the ground truth. The fallback says 'See your confirmation text', but members are only told about texts for late returns. A member who sees it looks for a message they were never promised and is left without their reservation details.
